nodes.label: DC45 Tech Spec EN Section 13: Site & Installation Requirements
DC45 Site Load Bearing 20-25T and levelness +/-0.5 deg
nodes.rationale: Ground load 20-25T (pro engineering assessment), levelness +/-0.5 deg, four-side maintenance clearance, dry cooler or cooling tower interface. Prioritize cold-dry climate (reduces DX, improves PUE); TCS inlet close to 26C reduces CeilAir compressor draw.
